Q: How can we prevent that DB2 fills blank chracters in Char Type? A:

In SQL, the CHAR data type is a fixed length character string. By definition, the additional characters are padded with spaces.

What you want is the VARCHAR data type. So, just change your data type for VARCHAR(8) and it will store your strings with no appended spaces.

By the way, this is true in all databases, not only DB2.

Q: Getting Intelij version error when I try to run a guidewire project, how do i solve it? A:

You will need to check the prerequisites (IntelliJ version, JDK version, Node.js version) to successfully open the studio.

  • To find out the IntelliJ version, you will execute command line gwb studio as you did. In this case, you need to reinstall IntelliJ 2022.3.
  • To find out the JDK version, you will read the file modules\script\gw-build.gradle.
  • To find out the Node.js version, you will read the file modules\configuration\webresources\package.json.

Q: Claude Code - Looking for guidance on where to start with coding and tools A:

There are lots of reliable sources / resources for leaning to program.

Look for a decent online or in-person programming course aimed at your current level of knowledge and budget. Or search your favorite online bookstore for "how to program" books.

Courses and books are unlikely to teach to teach you bad habits, 'cos they are prepared and/or reviewed by people who know how to teach.

With YouTube ... YMMV. Don't waste your time. The issue is not that they teach you bad habits. The real problem is that they are so superficial that they don't teach you much at all.

To learn to program you need to do it. Do all of the learning exercises, and then some. Programming is a practical skill. A good course or book will give you lots of exercises.
